summary: Iteration 10: Shop (Winkel) Token System + Trader Page New Features - ALL TESTS PASSED. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed. Frontend: All new features working correctly - Token shop with balance display, purchase flow, 15m candle interval, countdown timer, BCH-EUR locked chart.

Backend: GET /api/shop/balance/user-001 returns current token balance (4 tokens after test purchases)
Backend: POST /api/shop/buy/user-001 with priority-support deducts 3 tokens and returns success
Backend: POST /api/shop/buy/user-001 with ai-boost returns 'Item niet beschikbaar' error
Backend: POST /api/shop/buy/user-001 with insufficient tokens returns 'Onvoldoende tokens' error
Backend: GET /api/shop/purchases/user-001 returns purchase history (3 purchases)
Backend: GET /api/trade/candles?market=BCH-EUR&interval=15m&limit=10 returns 15-minute candle data
Backend: GET /api/trade/candles?market=BCH-EUR&interval=1h&limit=10 returns 1-hour candle data
Backend: GET /api/trade/candles?market=BCH-EUR&interval=4h&limit=10 returns 4-hour candle data

Backend: GET /api/trade/stats/user-001 still returns trade statistics (regression)
Backend: GET /api/trade/tickers still returns live prices (regression)
Backend: GET /api/trade/monitor/status still returns monitor status (regression)
Frontend: WinkelPage shows token balance badge in header (4 tokens)
Frontend: WinkelPage displays 6 shop items with correct prices
Frontend: WinkelPage 'Kopen' button deducts tokens and shows success message
Frontend: WinkelPage items too expensive show 'Te weinig tokens' disabled button
Frontend: WinkelPage unavailable items show 'Binnenkort' (AI Boost)

Frontend: TraderPage 15m interval loads 15-minute candle data and updates countdown label

Frontend: Navigation between pages works correctly (no regression)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Three new features tested this iteration: 1) Shop (Winkel) with token purchases - 6 items (custom-emoji 5t, kleur-thema 8t, priority-support 3t, extra-storage 4t, ai-boost 15t unavailable, gift-card 2t). Data-testids: winkel-page, token-balance, shop-item-{id}, buy-{id}, purchase-result, trade-page, interval-15m/1h/4h/1d, candle-countdown. Token data in /app/backend/data/wallet/user_wallets.json. Shop purchases in /app/backend/data/shop/purchases.json.
